name: Clear Cell Adenocarcinoma of the Ovary

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological and Immunohistochemical Diagnostic Criteria for Ovarian Clear Cell Carcinoma

criteria.description: Presence of clear cytoplasm with hobnail cells and tubulocystic, papillary, or solid growth patterns on histology
Positive staining for HNF-1β and Napsin A, and negative for WT1
Unilateral adnexal mass with or without pelvic pain or abdominal distension
Complex adnexal mass with solid and cystic components on ultrasound or MRI

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation with characteristic morphology plus supportive immunohistochemical profile
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other ovarian carcinoma subtypes and metastatic clear cell carcinomas.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Unilateral adnexal mass detected on imaging or physical exam
searchTerms: mass near ovary or fallopian tube

pathognomonic.symptomName: Pelvic or lower abdominal pain related to tumor mass effect
searchTerms: pelvic or lower belly pain from tumor
pain caused by tumor pressing on organs
lower abdominal discomfort due to mass

common.symptomName: Abdominal distension due to tumor or ascites
searchTerms: swollen abdomen from tumor or fluid
abdominal bloating from mass or fluid
fluid buildup in abdomen causing pain

occasional.symptomName: Urinary frequency or urgency due to pelvic mass effect
searchTerms: frequent or urgent urination from pelvic mass
bladder symptoms caused by pelvic tumor
urinary urgency due to mass effect
elevated calcium levels due to paraneoplastic syndrome
fluid around lungs from cancer spread

rare.symptomName: Neurological symptoms due to paraneoplastic syndromes
searchTerms: nerve symptoms from cancer-related immune effects
neurological signs due to paraneoplastic syndrome
nerve problems linked to cancer immune response

imaging: Complex adnexal mass with solid and cystic components on ultrasound
MRI showing characteristic tumor morphology with hemorrhagic cystic areas
CT scan for staging and detection of metastases
genetic: Loss of PTEN expression in some cases
other: Histopathology showing clear cytoplasm and hobnail cells
Immunohistochemistry positive for HNF-1β and Napsin A, negative for WT1

distinguishingFeatures: Usually WT1 negative but lacks HNF-1β expression
History of primary tumor elsewhere (e.g., kidney)
Immunohistochemical profile differs (e.g., PAX8, RCC marker)

redFlags: New onset thromboembolic events in a female patient
